out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Mechanical Ventilation System Capacity
violations.observation: Ventilation is not sufficient to keep rooms free of excessive vapors. OBSERVED FACILITY COOKING EGG PATTIES ON PORTABLE BURNERS THAT ARE NOT UNDER A HOOD SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: Provide mechanical ventilation at a sufficient capacity to minimize soiling of walls, ceilings, and equipment; efficiently remove obnoxious odors and toxic fumes; and prevent the creation of hazards or nuisances involving the accumulation of fats, oils. PIC REMOVED EQUIPMENT AND DISCONTINUED COOKING EGG PATTIES THIS WAY DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOKING FOODS IS NOT PERMITTED THIS WAY AS IT IS NOT UNDER A HOOD SYSTEM.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED YOGURT CUPS AT 47F AND YOGURT DRINKS AT 48-50F IN DISPLAY CASE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF YOGURTS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOOD TEMPERATURES ARE MONITORED IF THEY ARE KEPT IN THE DISPLAY CASE.
